sections_present: plasma exposure of ath-1105 and riluzole
morphometric analysis of the sciatic nerve
immunofluorescence analysis: neuronal survival, neurite network, extranuclear tdp-43, and lc3
immunofluorescence analysis: neuronal survival, neurite network, lamp2, and lc3
western blot analysis: phospho-gsk3β and phospho-tdp-43
treatment with ath-1105, riluzole, or their combination attenuates disease progression in the prp-tdp43a315t mouse model of als
ath-1105, but not riluzole, preserves large-diameter axons and myelination in sciatic nerves of als mice
differential effects of ath-1105 compared to riluzole on als-related biomarkers of neurodegeneration, inflammation, and tdp-43 protein pathology
ath-1105 enhances neuronal survival and neurite network, mitigates extranuclear tdp-43 accumulation, and reduces markers of autophagic stress in primary motor neuron culture
ath-1105 reduces tdp-43 phosphorylation at ser409/410 and increases gsk3β phosphorylation at ser9
the neuroprotective effects of ath-1105 on motor neurons are dependent on hgf/met system signaling
